# embedv1

```go
import embedv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/embed/v1"
```

Package embedv1 is the llm.embed/v1 contract: a model turns texts into vectors, for search by meaning.

A wire contract at /api/\_c/llm.embed/v1. In pb\_hooks it's $llm.embed.

Source: [`ext/contracts/llm/embed/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/llm/embed/v1).

<a id="w"></a>

```go
var W = extkit.NewWire(Contract, "llm", func(inner Embed, g *extkit.Guard[Embed]) Embed {
	return &guardEmbed{inner, g}
},
	extkit.Op[Embed]{
		Name:   "embed",
		Desc:   "Returns one vector per input text, in order.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "embed",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(EmbedInput{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Embed, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in EmbedInput
			if err := extkit.DecodeInput(req.JSON, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.Embed(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
	extkit.Op[Embed]{
		Name:   "models",
		Desc:   "Lists the embedding models of every provider in Settings → LLM.",
		Method: "GET",
		Path:   "models",
		Scope:  "llm:read",
		In:     reflect.TypeOf(llm.ModelsInput{}),
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Embed, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			var in llm.ModelsInput
			if err := extkit.DecodeQuery(req.Query, &in); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return impl.Models(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
)
```

W is llm.embed/v1's wire side: routes at /api/\_c/llm.embed/v1/\<op>, action hooks, MCP tools and the client.


Client is llm.embed/v1 over HTTP, for the CLI and other apps. It implements Embed; the token it was made with is the credential, so the extkit.Auth argument is ignored.

### Embed

```go
type Embed interface {
	// Embed returns one vector per input text, in order.
	//
	//op: POST embed
	Embed(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in EmbedInput) (Result, error)
	// Models lists the embedding models of every provider in Settings → LLM.
	//
	//op: GET models scope=llm:read
	Models(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in llm.ModelsInput) (llm.Models, error)
}
```

Embed turns texts into vectors.

### EmbedInput

```go
type EmbedInput struct {
	Model string   `json:"model"` // "provider/model", required
	Input []string `json:"input"`
	// Dimensions shortens the vectors, for models that allow it.
	Dimensions int         `json:"dimensions,omitempty"`
	Options    llm.Options `json:"options,omitempty"`
}
```

EmbedInput is the texts.

### Result

```go
type Result struct {
	Vectors [][]float64 `json:"vectors"`
	Model   string      `json:"model"`
	Usage   llm.Usage   `json:"usage"`
}
```

Result is the vectors, one per input.
